result.description: Compact battery-powered micro projector designed for outdoor presentations, pop-up classrooms, and travel briefings. Features a low-noise cooling system, integrated kickstand, dual-band wireless casting, and a ruggedized matte shell for mobile use. Includes USB-C power input and a built-in 16GB media buffer for offline playlists and slide decks.
